peak_drivers: Peak campus building occupancy & classroom plug load

action_plan.technical_details: Sub-cool primary lecture halls and high-thermal-mass concrete zones by 1.0°C to 1.5°C between 08:00 and 11:00. This shifts chiller electrical demand away from the high-tariff afternoon peak window.

action_plan.recommendation: Audit Supply Fan Static Pressure Setpoint
action_plan.technical_details: Reset AHU duct static pressure setpoint by -0.15 in. w.g. to allow variable frequency drives (VFDs) to ramp down safely without starving terminal VAV boxes.

action_plan.recommendation: Implement +1.0°C Peak Demand Offset in Non-Critical Spaces
action_plan.technical_details: Temporarily widen temperature deadbands by +1.0°C in common atria, departmental corridors, and administrative offices during flagged peak hours to curb compressor staging.

action_plan.recommendation: Conduct Peripheral Lighting & Computer Lab Sweep
action_plan.technical_details: Remotely trigger low-power standby on instructional computer labs and sweep exterior decorative / unoccupied conference room lighting.

action_plan.recommendation: Verify Fume Hood Sashes are Lowered
action_plan.technical_details: Encourage lab researchers to lower variable air volume (VAV) fume hood sashes to minimum stop when unmonitored. Maintain all EH&S air change safety compliance.
